scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsr generate && tsc && tsc -p test
scripts.ci: aube run commands --check && aube run check && aube run config:check && aube run typecheck && aube run test && aube run dev:setup && aube run build && aube run test:e2e

scriptsInfo.dev: Runs the site alone on http://localhost:4710, signed out unless a Gateweave ID is running
scriptsInfo.build: Builds the site for production into dist/
scriptsInfo.preview: Serves the production build on http://localhost:4711
scriptsInfo.snapshot: Saves every page of the build as plain HTML files in dist/snapshot/, for viewing without a server
scriptsInfo.typegen: Regenerates the Worker types and the route list
scriptsInfo.typecheck: Checks the TypeScript of the app and its tests
scriptsInfo.check: Checks formatting and lint with Biome
scriptsInfo.format: Fixes formatting and simple lint problems with Biome
scriptsInfo.test: Runs the unit tests, and the bookings tests in the real Workers runtime
scriptsInfo.test:e2e: Tests the production build in Chrome, signed out: every page, booking, the sign-in link, and Hallmark on every page
scriptsInfo.hallmark: Checks every page of the production build against Hallmark design rules (build first)
scriptsInfo.auth:schema: Regenerates the Better Auth database tables from the auth config
scriptsInfo.db:generate: Writes a database migration from the schema
scriptsInfo.db:migrate:local: Applies database migrations to the local database
scriptsInfo.dev:setup: First-time setup: writes .dev.vars with a random secret and sets up the local database
scriptsInfo.ci: Runs everything CI runs, in the same order. GitHub runs exactly this
scriptsInfo.config:check: Checks that the staging and production config is complete
scriptsInfo.commands: Regenerates docs/commands.md (--check fails if it is out of date)
